headline: Transatlantic Regulators Debate Foundation Model Systemic Risk Thresholds
summary_intro: Negotiators from North America and Europe convene to evaluate compute benchmark definitions for frontier AI governance ahead of upcoming enforcement deadlines.

sources.title: US and EU Convene Working Group on Frontier AI Safety Audits
sources.snippet: Joint working group sessions focused on harmonizing third-party auditing requirements for model deployments.

sources.snippet: Industry groups submitted formal comments citing potential trade secret disclosures in model card reporting requirements.

consensus.fact: All outlets confirm regulatory bodies are coordinating on joint auditing standards for frontier models.

sentences.text: Transatlantic AI safety institutes held joint sessions to harmonize red-teaming benchmarks for frontier foundation models.
